items.quote: Afterwards, the annealed samples were subjected to differential scanning calorimetry measurements (DSC, 404C, Netzsch, Germany) to determine the phase transition temperatures. Considering that the samples have been annealed at 750 °C for 70 days, the DSC device was carried out in Al2O3 crucibles with heating rate of 10 °C/min from 25 °C to 760 °C, 5 °C/min from 760 °C to 1350 °C, and cooling rate of 10 °C/min from 1350 °C to 25 °C. Pure metal standards In, Sn, Zn, Al, Ag, Au, Bi, and Ni were used for calibration to determine the temperature accurately within ± 2 °C.
